causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Hot temperatures drove high demand, greater than forecast.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Network constraints to maintain system security in NSW limited imports into Queensland over both the interconnectors thereby reducing Queensland's access to cheaper generation from NSW.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: An unplanned outage at Gladstone unit 2 removed 280 MW of available baseload capacity. In addition, 2 units at Millmerran experienced plant issues the day before and were not fully available.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Terranora, the other Queensland to NSW interconnector, was constrained by an ongoing outage of the Lismore static VAR compensator in NSW.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding of capacity for technical and commercial reasons contributed to all five of the 5 minute high-price intervals.

constraints_named.id: system normal constraint on the Bayswater to Liddell lines
constraints_named.quote: These reduced flows were due to a system normal constraint on the Bayswater to Liddell lines to maintain system security in NSW.

constraints_named.id: constraint to avoid the possible overload of the Lismore to Dunoon power lines
constraints_named.quote: Terranora, the other Queensland to NSW interconnector, was constrained by an ongoing outage of the Lismore static VAR compensator in NSW. To maintain system security, flows were forced into NSW, on average by 134 MW, during the high-priced period.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Hot temperatures drove very high demand, greater than forecast.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Network congestion limited flows into Queensland and NSW. Network congestion in northern NSW reduced Queensland's ability to access lower-priced energy through NSW. Network congestion in the south of NSW reduced NSW's ability to access lower-priced energy from within the region as well as from Victoria.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: AEMO invoked a constraint that limited flows out of Queensland, and this contributed to the high price in NSW. This constraint was violated to keep the system secure and contributed to setting the high price for the 7 pm period in NSW.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: The day before the high price, Genuity withdrew 85 MW of capacity from its Millmerran station, and a further 40 MW on the day of the high price, due to a tube leak. On the day of the high price, Stanwell Corporation withdrew 85 MW of capacity from its Tarong station due to a tube leak.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding for technical reasons contributed to the high prices.

constraints_named.id: system normal constraint on the Bayswater to Liddell lines
constraints_named.quote: This was because flows were forced into NSW to manage a system normal constraint in NSW on the Bayswater to Liddell lines, to avoid a possible overload (section 1.3).

constraints_named.id: system normal constraint in NSW to avoid the possible overloading of the Lismore to Dunoon power lines
constraints_named.quote: Terranora was limited by a system normal constraint in NSW to avoid the possible overloading of the Lismore to Dunoon power lines.

constraints_named.id: constraint to avoid overloading the Collector to Marulan line
constraints_named.quote: Flows through southern NSW were limited by a constraint to avoid overloading the Collector to Marulan line.

AEMO invoked a constraint that limited flows out of Queensland, and this contributed to the high price in NSW. This constraint was violated to keep the system secure and contributed to setting the high price for the 7 pm period in NSW.

interconnectors_named.name: Queensland to NSW Interconnector (QNI)
interconnectors_named.quote: In Queensland, during the 6.30 pm high price, the Queensland to NSW Interconnector (QNI) was exporting to NSW even though prices were lower in NSW.

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora
interconnectors_named.quote: Terranora, the other Queensland to NSW interconnector, was exporting only 4 MW into Queensland, compared to its nominal capacity of 107 MW.

interconnectors_named.name: Victoria to NSW interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: In NSW, the Victoria to NSW interconnector was importing an average of only 44 MW during the 7 pm high price, around 200 MW less than forecast, and substantially less than its nominal capacity of around 1,500 MW.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Hot temperatures and high humidity drove very high demand which was higher than forecast.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Network congestion limited flows through southern NSW. Multiple network constraints to manage congestion and to prevent overloading the network contributed to the high prices because they reduced access to low-priced generation from Victoria and southern NSW.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Actual wind and solar generation were much less than forecast around the same time.
